name: error-handling-design
description: Design end-to-end error handling for a product. Produces error taxonomy (validation / permission / network / third-party / server / data / rate-limit / deprecation), per-error message spec (plain-language / next action / technical code), prevention strategy, recovery flow, logging/observability handoff, and error-budget tie-in. Content tone and i18n guidance included. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
